project.title: WASH pulldown proteomics analysis
project.projectDescription: Affinity pulldown-paired quantitative proteomic analysis of HA-YFP-NLS.WASH interactors.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: HEK-293T cells expressing HA-YFP-NLS.WASH were lysed, subjected to subsequent anti-HA affinity purification, and analyzed by mass spectrometry.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Protein identification were performed with the Mascot against the uniprot20160315 Database.
